name: sandbroker-plugins
description: Keep credentials away from the model: sandbroker brokers them so they are never seen, leak-alarm catches the ones that get through anyway.

plugins.name: sandbroker
plugins.description: Use local secrets without seeing them. Adds the use-secret skill and the operating rules for the per-vault sandbroker MCP servers.

plugins.name: leak-alarm
plugins.description: Notice a live credential crossing a tool boundary. Denies a tool call carrying one, alerts on one that arrives in output, and adds the report-leak skill. Needs no broker and no vault.
